1.name: Netfilter, nftables/iptables, conntrack and NAT
unconditional: NFT_COUNTER is compiled into nf_tables when NF_TABLES=y; Linux 7.2-rc4 has no NFT_COUNTER Kconfig symbol.
1.runtime_test: Create/delete an isolated nft ruleset and test conntrack, forwarding and NAT in disposable namespaces; exercise iptables-nft and legacy tools without changing host rules.

2.name: IPv6
2.runtime_test: Test guest loopback, namespace veth traffic, router advertisements and routes; test passt external IPv6 separately.

3.name: User namespaces
3.runtime_test: As a non-root guest account, run unshare --user --map-root-user and verify the UID map.

4.name: PID namespaces
4.runtime_test: Start a nested PID namespace with procfs mounted; verify its PID 1 and cleanup.

5.name: Bridges
5.runtime_test: Bridge two veth-backed namespaces, pass traffic and remove all test links.

6.name: VETH
6.runtime_test: Create a veth pair, move endpoints into namespaces, pass packets, then remove them.

7.name: Cgroup memory limits
unconditional: Memory swap/accounting controls are integrated with MEMCG in this source; there is no separate MEMCG_SWAP Kconfig symbol.
7.runtime_test: Apply a temporary cgroup v2 memory.max to a bounded process and verify enforcement without guest OOM.

8.name: Cgroup process-count limits
8.runtime_test: Apply a small temporary pids.max, verify fork denial and clean up children.

9.name: Cgroup CPU quotas
9.runtime_test: Set cpu.max for a bounded CPU load and verify throttling counters.

10.name: OverlayFS
unconditional: Linux 7.2-rc4 has no EXT4_FS_XATTR Kconfig symbol; ext4 xattr handlers are built with EXT4_FS and EXT4_FS_SECURITY.
10.runtime_test: Mount lower/upper/work/merged on disposable persistent guest storage; verify copy-up and unmount.

11.name: FUSE
11.runtime_test: Verify /dev/fuse and perform a local FUSE mount/unmount; test remote tools only when endpoints exist.

12.name: SquashFS
12.runtime_test: Build and mount sample SquashFS images for each enabled compressor; read content and unmount.

13.name: ext4 POSIX ACLs
13.runtime_test: Set/get an ACL and prove access enforcement as a second guest user, including persistence.

14.name: ext4 security xattrs
14.runtime_test: Verify security.* xattrs and file-capability behavior with guest tools.

15.name: LSM framework and guest AppArmor
15.runtime_test: Verify AppArmor is active, load a disposable profile and observe a denial; Android host SELinux remains separate.

16.name: Kernel auditing
16.runtime_test: Install a disposable audit rule and observe its event; distinguish syscall auditing from audit messaging.

17.name: Kernel keyrings
17.runtime_test: Add/read/remove a temporary key with keyctl and verify permissions.

18.name: Kernel crypto API
18.runtime_test: Inspect crypto API inventory and run bounded AF_ALG or subsystem tests; userspace TLS alone is insufficient.

19.name: Device mapper and dm-crypt/LUKS
unconditional: The DM linear target is built into dm-mod when BLK_DEV_DM=y; this source has no DM_LINEAR Kconfig symbol.
19.runtime_test: Open a disposable loop-backed encrypted image, format/mount/read/write/unmount/close it; do not touch user disks.

20.name: eBPF program loading
20.runtime_test: Load and run a minimal BPF program and inspect it; report interpreter versus JIT and preserve seccomp.

21.name: Fanotify
21.runtime_test: Observe a file event; test permission events separately using a bounded local helper.

22.name: Traffic scheduling and shaping
22.runtime_test: Shape a test veth with a temporary qdisc, verify rate/counters, then remove the qdisc.

23.name: VLAN interfaces
23.runtime_test: Create tagged test interfaces, pass isolated VLAN traffic and clean up.

24.name: Multiple guest CPUs
24.runtime_test: Boot on a real compatible ARM64 host with at least two guest CPUs and exercise concurrent scheduling/network/PTY load.

25.name: Loadable modules
unconditional: Module signing is disabled because this guest has no private signing key; MODULE_SIG_FORCE is not enabled.
MODULES_TREE_LOOKUP stays disabled because it is selected only by PERF_EVENTS, TRACING or CFI, none of which is needed for module loading.
25.runtime_test: Build/load/unload a benign matching test module; verify vermagic, dmesg, exact release path and depmod metadata.

26.name: WireGuard
26.runtime_test: Create a guest WireGuard interface and complete a local namespace peer handshake/traffic test.

27.name: NFS client
27.runtime_test: Mount/read/write/unmount a disposable reachable NFS export; report unavailable endpoints.

28.name: SMB/CIFS client
28.runtime_test: Mount/read/write/unmount a disposable SMB3 share; do not commit credentials.

29.name: Btrfs
29.runtime_test: Format a disposable loop image, mount, write, snapshot, read and unmount.

30.name: XFS
30.runtime_test: Format an adequately sized disposable loop image, mount/read/write/unmount.

31.name: zram
31.runtime_test: Create a small zram device, set compressor/size, exercise bounded I/O/swap, then reset it.

32.name: zswap
32.runtime_test: Use a temporary swap backing store and bounded workload; verify enabled state and compressed-page activity.

33.name: Pressure Stall Information
33.runtime_test: Read /proc/pressure/{cpu,memory,io} and verify valid counters under bounded pressure.

34.name: Task statistics
34.runtime_test: Query taskstats with a real userspace client and verify delay/I/O accounting.
